connectionSpecification.description: Reads raw events through the Amplitude Export API and active users, average session length, cohorts, annotations and the event list through the Dashboard REST API.

active_users_group_by_country.description: Break the active_users counts down by country. Default true.
active_users_group_by_country.title: Active Users Group by Country

api_key.description: API key of the Amplitude project, in Settings > Projects.
api_key.title: API Key

data_region.description: Region the Amplitude project stores its data in: "Standard Server" (amplitude.com) or "EU Residency Server" (analytics.eu.amplitude.com).
data_region.title: Data Region

request_time_range.description: Hours of events one Export API request covers, 1 to 8760. A window the API rejects as too large is split in half until it is accepted. Default 24.
request_time_range.title: Request Time Range

secret_key.description: Secret key of the Amplitude project, in Settings > Projects.
secret_key.title: Secret Key

start_date.description: UTC time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ, from which data is read. Events are read from the start of its hour, the daily metrics from its day.
start_date.title: Start Date

connectionSpecification.title: Amplitude Source Spec
